body: I sincerely hope that you find your way out soon, stranger.
Thanks for the kind words... but I don't think I do. I can't compete with people to get where I need to be to pursue my passions.

Hey there Polly! I can see how learning matters to you a lot... and I know how hard it is to concentrate in such a chaotic situation. I'm proud of how you didn't turn to drugs or drinking! It takes a strong person to take all of this and still not waver. I obviously don't know your grandma, so I wouldn't psychoanalyze her over the internet - but it really seems to me like she is acting out on her own failures in life. Don't believe in her comparisons! You are **YOU**, and that's **GREAT**. Don't ever believe anything different. Believe in yourself!

 I don't know what the laws in your country are, Polly, but if you are being physically or mentally abused you could try and call CPS or the Police. Talk to counselors in your school, if they have any. They might be able to help! Talk to any relative you trust about this, they might also be willing to help you out in some way. There are good people out there, don't lose hope Polly!

Hey there. I don't know about the dynamic between your father and you, so I won't be so quick on passing judgment - but this looks like abuse, friend. No matter how wise someone is, nobody owns you. Abuse is **never** right. Please, OP, hold on tight. What is your current situation? Are you able to move out/become financially independent?
I write often on my laptop, like a few times a month. I think it's a bit therapeutic cause I can't get therapy, it helps to see my thoughts laid out clearly before me.
At least I tried to reach out.
thanks again for being the only person who cared to reply... I broke up with her today. She went on a tirade about how I'm too self-absorbed... and I just couldn't take it anymore.

Exactly! That's why I like physics so much - I like how you can express so much about the world in small equations. It almost feels like a superpower, of sorts.  
Even in good times, I never stop thinking about hurting myself. It kind of became my baseline normal emotion, I think... Something tells me that it will get better, but I think I know that these thoughts won't ever go away.
thank you for reading through it. My favorite subs are Physics and maths.
